title: ALDER HOUSE — A shared living room for different everyday needs, 14 deliverables

config.text:
# ALDER HOUSE

## Project
- Shared living room for four older residents and one daytime caregiver
- Floor area: 43.20 m²
- Spatial arrangement: one open room
- Zone names: Rest; Together; Arrival
- Zone areas: design allocation totaling 43.20 m², including circulation within the three zones
- Printed project name: ALDER HOUSE
- Room sign wording: Rest; Together

## Room survey
| Element | Existing record | Retention |
|---|---|---|
| Coordinates | Origin at southwest internal corner; x east; y north; z upward; coordinates in m | Fixed |
| Internal shell | x = 0.00–7.20 m; y = 0.00–6.00 m; floor z = 0.00 m; ceiling z = 2.70 m | Fixed |
| D1 | South wall; x = 0.60–1.80 m; opening 1.20 m wide, 2.10 m high; hinge at west jamb; outward swing south | Fixed |
| D2 | East wall; y = 0.60–1.80 m; opening 1.20 m wide, 2.10 m high; hinge at south jamb; outward swing east | Fixed |
| W1 | North wall; x = 0.80–3.20 m; sill z = 0.75 m; head z = 2.25 m | Fixed |
| W2 | North wall; x = 4.00–6.40 m; sill z = 0.75 m; head z = 2.25 m | Fixed |
| Thresholds | D1 and D2 level with internal floor | Fixed |
| Columns and service shafts | 0 | Existing condition |
| Internal partitions | 0 | Open room arrangement |
| Existing finishes | Replaceable wall, floor and ceiling finishes | Refurbishment scope |
| Surface wiring | New surface routes for lighting and call button | Refurbishment scope |

## Furniture inventory
| ID | Item | Quantity | Dimensions in mm | Recognizable features | Status |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| F1 | Oak armchair | 2 | W 720 × D 760 × H 900; seat H 460; arm top H 660 | Rounded oak arms, four square tapered legs, upholstered rectangular seat and back | Retained frames; UP-01 upholstery renewal |
| F2 | Oak activity table | 1 | L 1600 × W 900 × H 740; one short-end knee space W 800 × D 600 × H 700 | Rounded rectangular top, four corner legs, shallow apron | Retained; WD-01 refinishing |
| F3 | Oak sideboard | 1 | W 1400 × D 450 × H 800 | Three flat doors, round wooden pulls, recessed plinth | Retained; WD-01 refinishing |
| F4 | Additional armchair | 3 | W 560 × D 600 × H 850; seat H 460; arm top H 660 | Firm upholstered seat, arms, four legs | New; WD-01 frame and UP-01 upholstery |

## Selected support equipment
| ID | Item | Quantity | Dimensions in mm | Position or allocation | Appearance |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| H1 | Straight support rail | 1 | L 1200; grip diameter 40; wall-to-grip clear gap 50 | South wall x = 2.20–3.40 m; centerline z = 0.80 m | Matte dark brown #4A382B; round grip; two returned wall brackets |
| H2 | Wired call button | 1 | W 80 × H 80 × D 20 | South wall x = 3.40 m; centerline z = 0.90 m; cable route to D1 | Warm white square plate; dark brown circular button |
| H3 | Four-wheel walker | 1 | W 600 × D 700 × H 850 | Dedicated dock W 700 × D 800; position within Arrival | Matte graphite frame; four black wheels; two handles; fabric basket |
| U1 | Ada's occupied wheelchair envelope | 1 | W 700 × D 1200 | Activity-table short-end position during seated activities | Personal mobility equipment |

## Spatial dimensions
| Feature | Dimension |
|---|---|
| Continuous route between D1, D2 and occupied zones | Clear width 1200 mm with seats occupied |
| Turning space beside F2 | Diameter 1500 mm |
| Assistance space beside one F1 | 800 × 900 mm |
| H3 dock | 700 × 800 mm |
| F2 wheelchair knee clearance | W 800 × D 600 × H 700 mm |
| Room sign capital height | 25 mm |
| Room sign mounting centerline | 1200 mm above floor |

## Materials and recognition
| Code | Material and treatment | Location | Color or visual relationship |
|---|---|---|---|
| FL-01 | Sheet linoleum, matte finish, flush welded seams | Continuous room floor | Warm beige #B8AA92 |
| WL-01 | Scrubbable matte paint | Walls and ceiling | Warm white #EEE8DC |
| WD-01 | Existing oak sanded and finished with clear matte lacquer; matching oak for F4 | F1 frames, F2, F3 and F4 frames | Visible natural oak grain |
| UP-01 | Tightly woven upholstery with removable seat covers | F1 and F4 seats and backs | Deep olive #4F5B43 |
| AC-01 | Wool felt panel on concealed backing; W 1800 × H 900 × D 25 mm | South wall x = 4.20–6.00 m; lower edge z = 1.20 m; upper edge z = 2.10 m | Taupe #9B8C79 |
| SG-01 | Matte painted aluminum signs with printed lettering | Rest and Together zones | Dark brown #4A382B lettering on warm white #EEE8DC |

## Lighting
| ID | Layer | Type and quantity | Position | Control |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| L1 | Ambient | 4 diffused surface ceiling lights | Distributed over occupied zones and connecting route | Separate dimmer near D1, centerline 1000 mm above floor |
| L2 | Task | 1 diffused linear pendant | Centered above F2; underside 1900 mm above floor | Separate dimmer near D1, centerline 1000 mm above floor |
| L3 | Accent | 1 shielded linear wall light | Above F3 | Separate dimmer near D1, centerline 1000 mm above floor |
- Light source color temperature: 3000 K for L1, L2 and L3
- Furniture positions: consistent across all three occupied scenes

## Perspective coordinates
| View | Time | Camera x, y, z in m | Target x, y, z in m |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 14:00 | 1.00, 1.60, 1.50 | 4.20, 4.40, 1.10 |
| B | 16:00 | 6.30, 4.90, 1.50 | 2.80, 2.10, 1.10 |
| C | 19:00 | 6.10, 1.00, 1.50 | 2.00, 4.30, 1.10 |

# ALDER HOUSE — delivery catalog

This table lists every commissioned deliverable with its tier, file format and stage. What each deliverable must contain is stated in the commission letter.

| # | id | Deliverable | Tiers | Format and stage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | functional-schedule | Functional and furniture schedule | 14 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: process. |
| 2 | furnished-plan | Furnished room plan | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 3 | south-elevation | South internal elevation | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 4 | east-elevation | East internal elevation | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | route-dock-detail | Route and walker dock detail | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | assisted-seat-detail | Armchair and assistance detail | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 7 | table-access-detail | Activity table access detail | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 8 | materials-recognition | Materials and recognition board | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 9 | lighting-acoustics | Lighting and acoustic plan | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 10 | afternoon-perspective | Afternoon conversation perspective | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 11 | activity-perspective | Shared activity perspective | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 12 | evening-perspective | Evening rest perspective | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 13 | room-walkthrough | Ten-second room walkthrough | 14 | Format: video; 5 to 15 seconds. Stage: final. |
| 14 | household-presentation | Household decision presentation | 14 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final. |

# ALDER HOUSE resident routines

## People
| Name | Role | Everyday need | Spatial implication |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ada | Resident | Wheelchair use; seated participation in puzzles and cards | Short-end table position, knee clearance and turning space |
| Ben | Resident | Walker use; seated rest after crossing the room | Walker dock near seating and a continuous route to both doors |
| Clara | Resident | Reduced vision; difficulty distinguishing similar pale surfaces | Dark seat edges against the floor, readable zone signs and diffuse table lighting |
| David | Resident | Short rests; preference for watching activity before joining | Armchair within sight of the table and an adjacent assistance space |
| Erin | Daytime caregiver | Support with materials, seating and conversation | Reachable sideboard and assistance space beside one armchair |

## Shared-use periods
| Time | People present | Rest | Together | Arrival and equipment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14:00–14:30 | Ada, Ben, Clara, David, Erin | Clara and David talking in the two F1 armchairs | Ada and Ben sorting picture cards; Erin seated with them | H3 parked in its dock; H1 and H2 accessible |
| 16:00–17:00 | Ada, Ben, Clara, David, Erin | David resting in one F1 armchair | Ada, Ben and Clara completing a puzzle; Erin seated at the table | H3 parked in its dock; H1 and H2 accessible |
| 19:00–19:30 | Ben, David | Ben and David resting in the two F1 armchairs | Table unoccupied | H3 parked in its dock; L1 dimmed; L2 off; L3 on |

## Occupancy
- Maximum simultaneous occupancy: 5 people
- Together seating: Ada's wheelchair and 3 F4 chairs
- Rest seating: 2 F1 armchairs
- Furniture arrangement: identical across the three periods
- Movable activity materials: picture cards at 14:00; puzzle at 16:00; clear tabletop at 19:00

steps.userMessage:
ALDER HOUSE | A shared living room for different everyday needs

We are refurbishing the shared living room at ALDER HOUSE for four older residents and one daytime caregiver. The room measures 7.20 m east–west by 6.00 m north–south, with a clear height of 2.70 m. Coordinates start at the southwest internal corner; x runs east, y north and z upward. On the south wall, D1 occupies x = 0.60–1.80 m; on the east wall, D2 occupies y = 0.60–1.80 m. Both openings are 1.20 m wide and 2.10 m high, with doors opening outward. North windows W1 and W2 occupy x = 0.80–3.20 m and x = 4.00–6.40 m respectively; both have sills at 0.75 m and heads at 2.25 m. Retain this shell, its level thresholds and its open room arrangement. The room has no columns or service shafts.

The oak armchairs, activity table and sideboard belong to the household and will remain in use. Ada uses a wheelchair, Ben uses a walker, Clara needs clear visual edges, and David prefers short rests within sight of company. Erin supports shared activities. Organize three zones named Rest, Together and Arrival, with a continuous 1200 mm clear route between D1, D2 and the occupied zones, a 1500 mm turning circle beside the activity table, and an 800 × 900 mm assistance space beside one armchair. Retain the selected support rail, call button and walker. Use the material and lighting records to establish matte surfaces, visible furniture edges and separately controlled ambient, task and accent light. Print "ALDER HOUSE" on the furnished plan and presentation cover. Print "Rest" and "Together" on their respective room signs, using 25 mm capital height and sign centerlines 1200 mm above the floor.

Audience: the residents, Erin and the household manager, deciding the furniture arrangement, finishes and installation priorities.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the room survey, retained inventory, support equipment, finish records and lighting requirements. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the deliverables, proportions, formats and stages. 03-resident-routines.en.md records individual needs and the three shared-use periods. existing-room-survey.png supplies the fixed shell geometry and clearance dimensions. retained-furniture.png records the recognizable forms of the oak furniture. selected-support-equipment.png records the selected rail, call button and walker. afternoon-conversation.png supplies domestic conversation context. shared-table-activity.png supplies the social context of a seated activity with caregiver support.

Deliverables:
1. One functional and furniture schedule, stating the three zone names, their individual areas totaling 43.20 m², occupancy, furniture and equipment quantities and dimensions, and material codes FL-01, WL-01, WD-01, UP-01, AC-01 and SG-01
2. One furnished plan with the schedule's zone areas and inventory, both door swings, the narrowest route dimensions, the turning circle, assistance space, equipment positions and three camera positions
3. Two dimensioned internal elevations, south and east, showing floor and ceiling levels, door openings, the rail and call button, room signs and applicable material codes
4. Three enlarged details: the entrance-to-seating route and walker dock; an armchair with its assistance space; the activity table with wheelchair approach and knee clearance
5. One materials and recognition board with six coded finishes, their locations and treatments, the two room signs and their lettering dimensions
6. One lighting and acoustic plan locating L1 ambient ceiling lights, L2 table task light, L3 sideboard accent light, three separate controls and the AC-01 wall panel
7. Three occupied room perspectives: afternoon conversation at 14:00 from A (1.00, 1.60, 1.50 m) toward (4.20, 4.40, 1.10 m); shared activity at 16:00 from B (6.30, 4.90, 1.50 m) toward (2.80, 2.10, 1.10 m); evening rest at 19:00 from C (6.10, 1.00, 1.50 m) toward (2.00, 4.30, 1.10 m)
8. One 10-second room walkthrough following the route from D1 to the activity table and ending on the support rail and call button
9. One presentation document of at least eight pages, reusing the schedule, plan, elevations, details, material board, lighting plan and occupied perspectives, with an installation sequence

Acceptance:
- The furnished plan, two elevations, three perspectives and walkthrough retain the 7.20 × 6.00 × 2.70 m room, D1, D2, W1 and W2 at their recorded positions; furniture and installed equipment occupy matching positions across these deliverables.
- The schedule, furnished plan and presentation repeat Rest, Together and Arrival, the same three areas totaling 43.20 m², two F1 armchairs, one F2 table, one F3 sideboard, three F4 chairs and one each of H1, H2 and H3. The plan and presentation carry ALDER HOUSE.
- The furnished plan and three enlarged details dimension the 1200 mm clear route with seats occupied, 1500 mm turning circle, 800 × 900 mm assistance space, 700 × 800 mm walker dock and F2 knee clearance of 800 mm wide, 600 mm deep and 700 mm high; the armchair detail repeats its 460 mm seat and 660 mm arm heights.
- The elevations, support details and presentation locate H1 on the south wall at x = 2.20–3.40 m and 800 mm centerline height, with H2 at x = 3.40 m and 900 mm centerline height. The three perspectives collectively show H1, H2 and H3; the walkthrough ends with H1 and H2 visible.
- The material board, furnished plan and presentation repeat all six material codes from the schedule. The elevations and perspectives carry the corresponding finishes, with Rest and Together legible across the perspective set. The material board dimensions both signs at 25 mm capital height and 1200 mm mounting centerline; the lighting plan and presentation locate L1–L3, their three controls and the 1800 × 900 mm AC-01 panel.
- The three occupied perspectives depict the named people and activities in the 14:00, 16:00 and 19:00 records, using the same furniture arrangement. The presentation pairs each scene with its time and relevant resident need, reuses all seven earlier drawing and schedule categories, and contains at least eight pages; the walkthrough runs for 10 seconds.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
